Title: Patrologiae graecae tomus CLXI: Bessarion S.R.E. cardinalis. Bessarionis Opera omnia, theologica, exegetica, polemica, partim jam edita, partim hucusque anecdota. Tomus unicus
Creator: Bessarion, archbishop of Nicaea and cardinal; Greek texts with Latin, edited by J.-P. Migne, with the Life by Aloysius Bandini and other editors' prolegomena
Publisher: Paris: J.-P. Migne (Petit-Montrouge), Patrologiae cursus completus, Series graeca, tomus 161
Publication Date: 1866
Rights: Public Domain
Rights basis: the title page carries no year in this scan's OCR; the list of Migne's volumes printed in this same file reads 'CLXI (1866). Bessarion, I-CLVI et 1-746' (file line 110988). Host record: date field 1857 (the series start), possible-copyright-status NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT.
Language: grc (Greek with parallel or following Latin translation; the Latin and Greek share the OCR file; see the content note)
Source: Internet Archive item patrologicursus89migngoog (archive.org/details/patrologicursus89migngoog), full-text file patrologicursus89migngoog_djvu.txt, fetched directly by the Library thread, October 2026.
Provenance note: Header prepended by the Library thread; the OCR text follows it unchanged. Nothing was stripped, normalised, corrected, re-spaced or retyped (the long s glyph occurs 0 times and was left as found). The Google Books boilerplate page at the head of the OCR is left in place. The OCR text that follows is 5547336 bytes, 4323979 characters and 131252 lines. OCR quality sampled at the title pages and at about 5%, 50% and 95% of the file (lines 6575, 65639 and 124702): Latin readable with ordinary OCR slips (c for e, rn for m); Greek in the same polytonic OCR as the other Migne volumes.
Content note: Bessarion's works as the volume's ELENCHUS lists them: the Refutation of Mark of Ephesus's syllogistic chapters against the Latins; the Apologia for the inscriptions of Beccus against Gregory Palamas; the Defences of the Latin dogma on the procession of the Holy Spirit; the Encyclical to the Greeks urging obedience to Rome and acceptance of the Council of Florence; the Greek confession on the words of consecration; the Oratio dogmatica on the union of the churches delivered at Ferrara; the Oratio gratulatoria; letters; and the Lives and prolegomena that open the volume. The file ends with the Migne tables of volumes (from about line 110013), which are index matter, not text of Bessarion.

Indices in seriem graecam Patrologi& cursus completi accurante J.-P. MicNE hac 
ratione instituti sunt : 


Brevis primum catalogus exhibetur, ex ordine voluminum, ut uno quasi conspectu 
qui scriptores in universa serie contineantur intelligatur. Sequitur index alphabeticus 
auctorum in quo tituli tum scriptionum veterum tum recentiorum commentationum 
et indicum, additis columnarum numeris, dilucide simul atque accurate, quod fieri 
potuit, significantur. Qua in re ne quid viri docti desiderent, nomine inter uncos in- 
cluso, ea editio indicatur ad cujus exemplum v. cl. J.-P. MicNE suam adornavit. 
Index etiam methodicus additus est ita confectus ut scriptiones grece pro argumento 
in varias tabellas dispertiantur de re dogmatica, scripturaria, hagiographica, etc. Qui- 
bus in appendicem indiculi quidam breviores subjunguntur, non sane spernendi iis qui 
e thesauro Patrologie grece opes sibi plurimas comparare velint. Quod ad rationem 
vocabula scribendi spectat eam, quamvis non ubique laudandam, qus in ceteris vo- 
luminibus seriei ab editore adhibita est, retinendam esse censuimus. 

Qui labor ut reipublice christiane atque bonarum artium in utilitatem cedat, 
Deum Optimum Maximum ex animo deprecamur. 


Tolose, in die festo S. Joannis Chrysostomi, 27 Januarii 1912. 


Ferdinandus CAvALLERa.
